Rule.name: fixed-feb-10-mt
Rule.comment: Nawfraġju ta' San Pawl. Commemorates the shipwreck of the Apostle Paul on Malta, traditionally dated to AD 60.

Rule.name: fixed-mar-19-mt
Rule.comment: Festa ta' San Ġużepp. Feast of Saint Joseph, observed on 19 March.

Rule.name: fixed-mar-31-mt
Rule.comment: Jum il-Ħelsien. Marks the withdrawal of the last British forces and the Royal Navy from Malta on 31 March 1979.

Rule.name: fixed-jun-07-mt
Rule.comment: Commemorates the riots of 7 June 1919, when British troops fired on a crowd protesting economic conditions, a milestone toward self-government.

NotableDate.name: Feast of Saint Peter and Saint Paul

Rule.name: fixed-jun-29-mt
Rule.comment: L-Imnarja. One of Malta's oldest folk festivals, honoring the apostles Peter and Paul on 29 June.

Rule.name: fixed-sep-08-mt
Rule.comment: Jum il-Vitorja. Marks the end of the Great Siege of 1565 and the Nativity of Mary, and commemorates the end of the Second Siege of Malta in 1943.

Rule.name: fixed-sep-21-mt
Rule.comment: Jum l-Indipendenza. Marks Malta's independence from the United Kingdom on 21 September 1964.

Rule.name: fixed-dec-13-mt
Rule.comment: Jum ir-Repubblika. Marks the establishment of the Republic of Malta on 13 December 1974.
